claimlint checks Python documentation and agent instructions against source evidence without a model.

- Seven check families cover CLI options, symbols, example signatures, opt-in example execution, settings/environment references, relative links, and agent command recipes.
- Text, JSON and GitHub annotations include source evidence and explicit skipped coverage.
- Baselines and inline suppressions support adoption in existing projects.
- Optional Codex fixes are documentation-only, validated statically, and previewed before applying.
- Python 3.10+; default checks never import the checked project.

Install with `python -m pip install claimlint==0.1.0`, then run `claimlint check .`.

Runtime help and examples require explicit flags and trusted code. See the README and analysis limits for supported static patterns.
